summary.headline: World-Year Ascendant Calculations
summary.text: Methods for extracting the world-year ascendant and its indicator, beginning with a vernal-equinox calculation tied to Alexandria, Yazdgerd 966, Alexander the Great, Ghazan, and Genghis Khan. It then gives two methods from Ulugh Beg’s new Zij, detailing solar motion, ascensions, apogee, equatorial centers, equations, and incident centers.
